dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: What a way to win. I've been schooled.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Good game, but I think you let me win.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: What an efficient technique. Really admirable.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: How breathtaking... Thank you for being merciful.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hey, Honorary Knight! Wait up a moment!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who, me?

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Haha, who but you would be Mondstadt's famous Honorary Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: That said, you haven't gotten a copy of the Knights of Favonius Handbook yet, have you? It contains the vast majority of the principles that Knights should follow, as well as some knowledge for common use.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: As an Honorary Knight, you should at least be familiar with some of this.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I requisitioned a copy from the Knights just for you. Please give it a read.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Once you're done, I'll quiz you a little. This will involve some content recorded in the handbook, as well as some common-sense questions.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Depending on how you answer, I'll also be giving you a small gift.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Hi. Anything the Knights can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I'm Swan. I mostly perform sentry duty.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I also provide any necessary assistance to our business visitors in accordance with the Knights of Favonius Handbook.

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: Yes. The Knights of Favonius Handbook is our instructional guide, and also the cornerstone of peace and prosperity in Mondstadt...

choices.text: Is there anywhere good to go in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: ...Sorry, I can't find anything at all about that in the Knights of Favonius Handbook...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Bye-bye!

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: May Barbatos and his gentle wind protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: We are currently experiencing abnormal weather patterns. It is dangerous outside. Citizens are advised to seek shelter.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: That dragon could return at any time. The Knights of Favonius will keep watch; everyone else is urged to find shelter immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: This is an emergency. Please be assured that the Knights of Favonius' first priority is to guarantee the safety of everyone in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Stormterror? One moment, let me try to recall the Knights of Favonius Handbook...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't remember anything in there that tells us what to do when facing giant dragons.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Oh, but I do remember that it does mention how to deal with sudden threats:

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: "When danger is imminent, please do not panic. Cover your head with both hands, and crouch down to protect your vital parts."

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: I think I'll do as this says...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: It's over at last. We can finally breathe easy.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: We should suggest to the higher-ups that we need to add "what to do in the event of a giant dragon's appearance" to the Knights of Favonius Handbook.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Still, such a thing is unlikely to happen a second time...
